article.title: Pacers host the Rockets in out-of-conference matchup
article.linkText: Pacers host the Rockets in out-of-conference matchup
article.story: Houston Rockets (11-4, third in the Western Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (5-9, 10th in the Eastern Conference) Indianapolis; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Indiana Pacers host the Houston Rockets in non-conference action. The Pacers are 2-5 in home games. Indiana is at the bottom of the Eastern Conference with just 41.6 rebounds per game led by Pascal Siakam averaging 6.2. The Rockets are 4-3 on the road. Houston ranks ninth in the NBA scoring 15.5 fast break points per game led by Kevin Durant averaging 3.4. The Pacers average 112.1 points per game, 2.6 more points than the 109.5 the Rockets allow. The Rockets average 12.7 made 3-pointers per game this season, 1.4 fewer made shots on average than the 14.1 per game the Pacers allow. TOP PERFORMERS: Andrew Nembhard is shooting 44.6% and averaging 16.6 points for the Pacers. Siakam is averaging 20.6 points over the last 10 games. Alperen Sengun is averaging 22.8 points, 9.3 rebounds and 7.2 assists for the Rockets. Durant is averaging 20.8 points over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Pacers: 3-7, averaging 110.3 points, 41.0 rebounds, 27.2 assists, 7.4 steals and 3.7 blocks per game while shooting 46.4% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 114.3 points per game. Rockets: 6-4, averaging 115.2 points, 46.0 rebounds, 27.0 assists, 6.3 steals and 5.5 blocks per game while shooting 46.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 109.9 points. INJURIES: Pacers: Tyrese Haliburton: out (hamstring), Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl), Andrew Nembhard: day to day (hip). Rockets: Amen Thompson: out (knee), Clint Capela: out (ankle), Steven Adams: out (leg). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
